items.prompt:
Read the story below.

King the dog waited by the door all day. He did not eat. He did not sleep. When he heard a sound, his ears went up.

The illustration shows King sitting by the door with his ears perked and his eyes looking hopefully at the door handle. A leash hangs on the wall. What can you figure out about what King is waiting for? Use clues from both the words and the illustration.
items.answer: King is waiting for his owner to come home. The words say he would not eat or sleep and his ears went up when he heard a sound. The illustration shows him looking hopefully at the door and a leash on the wall. Together these clues show he is excited and waiting for someone, probably for a walk or for his owner to return.

steps: Read the word clues: King did not eat or sleep and his ears perked at sounds.
Look at the illustration clues: King stares hopefully at the door and a leash hangs on the wall.
Combine the clues: Not eating or sleeping plus watching the door eagerly means King misses his owner.
The leash on the wall suggests he wants to go for a walk with his owner.

The twins ran to the window every morning. They checked the big thermometer outside. Then they looked at each other.

The illustration shows the thermometer reading very low, with the needle near the bottom. Outside the window there is snow and ice on the branches. The twins are wearing pajamas and have big smiles and are giving a thumbs up.

What can you figure out about why the twins are smiling? Use both the words and illustration.
items.answer: The twins are smiling because it is very cold and snowy outside. They probably hope school will be canceled due to snow. The low thermometer and snow outside explain why they are so excited, and the thumbs up shows they are happy about what they see.

steps: Word clues: The twins check the thermometer every morning, then look at each other.
Illustration clues: The thermometer shows a very low temperature, snow and ice are outside, and the twins give a thumbs up in their pajamas.
Low temperature plus snow plus happy pajama-wearing kids suggests a snow day.
Children are often excited when school might be canceled due to cold and snow.

The illustration shows the bear standing in a shallow river with his paw raised above the water. Several fish are visible swimming beneath the surface. The bear's eyes are focused on the fish.

items.answer: The bear is trying to catch fish in the river. The words say he goes to the river every morning, stands very still, and waits. The illustration shows his paw raised above fish in the water, ready to swipe. Standing still and waiting are hunting behaviors, and the raised paw confirms he is about to catch a fish.

Illustration clues: The bear's paw is raised over fish in the water, and his eyes are focused on them.
A raised paw over fish in water is a classic image of a bear fishing.
Standing still and waiting plus the raised paw together show the bear is hunting for fish.
